description: Vaarweg - Camera's is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Camera's langs en aan de provinciale vaarwegen die binnen het beheer van de provincie Zuid-Holland vallen. Weergegeven als punten. Per 14-5-2025 zijn de Vaarweg ondersteunende camera’s voorzien van een controle en zijn up to date. De vaarweg ondersteunende camera’s worden gebruikt om overzicht te hebben op het water t.b.v. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are binnenscheepvaart, camera, pleziervaart, recreatievaart, scheepvaart. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
